name: ra11y-vscode
description: IDE-native accessibility findings powered by the ra11y MCP server

ra11y.standard.description: Accessibility standard ID(s) to evaluate. Comma-separated to enable multiple (e.g. 'wcag22,section508'). Forwarded to scan_project.

ra11y.additionalPaths.description: Extra paths to scan beyond the auto-discovered tree (e.g. 'dist/assets' to include post-compile CSS). Passed through to scan_project.additionalPaths.

ra11y.command.description: Executable used to spawn the MCP server. Defaults to 'ra11y' (resolved on PATH). Set to an absolute path to pin to a specific installation.

ra11y.minSeverity.description: Minimum severity to surface in the Problems panel. 'info' matches the recommended scan_project default.

ra11y.scanOnSave.description: Re-run a scan when a supported file is saved.
